content:
Here's something funny about anime: 

You know you've watched too much anime when you start running with your arms straight back like Naruto characters, thinking it'll make you faster... only to realize you just look like a malfunctioning airplane in the school hallway.

Or how about the fact that anime characters can have full emotional breakdowns, flashback to their entire childhood, AND deliver a 10-minute motivational speech... all while their opponent's punch is still traveling through the air in slow motion. That punch has been in transit longer than most Amazon packages! 📦👊
